releaseNotes.headline: Clean up generated files
releaseNotes.summary: Scan main checkouts and linked worktrees for generated files. Review the paths and confirm permanent deletion. usAIge rechecks each folder before removing it.

highlights.title: Storage cleanup
highlights.detail: Find generated dependencies, Xcode build files, and selected tool caches. Largest Folders shows measured sizes for inspection.

highlights.title: Safer worktree review
highlights.detail: Ignored contents are checked before bulk review. If ignored files change after review, usAIge asks you to review the worktree again.

highlights.title: More reliable Claude usage refresh
highlights.detail: The macOS app keeps a valid usage reading during brief rewrites of the Claude Desktop cache and checks freshness before reusing it.
